decision.summary: No management action and no valid new BTC price-hit entry this cycle.
decision.rationale: The active weekly 82k reach position is at 0.765, below the 80-85% partial take-profit band and below the 90% full take-profit zone, so it should be held. Reconciliation is ok, cash is available, and there are no discarded positions. Latest Beecthor context is D-1, structurally bearish but still allows an upside sweep toward 81k-85k before a later sell zone; Binance is bullish at 81014.05 with BTC +1153.04 from the UTC open and near the 24h high. That blocks fresh same-direction daily reach entries under the UTC-day move cooling rule, while bearish DIP entries lack the required Binance rejection evidence. The weekly thesis slot is already occupied, and the next 84k weekly reach would add extra bullish exposure before 82k has resolved, so there is no clean additional edge.
